_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base-rate (score ±2 in only 7% of 12h windows) plus flat leg keep the phase inside 47-54; opex/post-FOMC is a price skew, not a ±2 breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst owns the BTC phase/short call; narrative is silent on phase and only notes metals weakness
next_move.confirmed_if: Composite/F&G stays 45-55 and 30d momentum near 50 through Friday opex with no ±2 score break
next_move.invalidated_if: Score breaks below 39 (Anxiety) on liquidation, or ETF flows reverse and score pushes above 55 (Disbelief)
